project_description: Completed hybrid backend connector architecture: essential backends remain static builtins while optional connectors are independently buildable executable gRPC plugins with a versioned ABI, closed trusted manifest discovery, digest-bound launch, secure local IPC, lazy declared process activation, fail-closed unsupported-platform posture, and root-module isolation. Local release/security/cross-platform/parity gates and exact-SHA Windows, Ubuntu, and macOS workflow evidence are recorded.
